meta.project_name_cn: 电商增长 Agent 工作台

project_overview.positioning: A ToB multi-agent ecommerce growth workflow demo that turns product briefs into governed, auditable, reviewable and evaluable structured creative planning packages.
project_overview.demo_product_rule: Use only 运动相机 as the demo product name; do not convert technical parameters into product naming or unsupported facts.
project_overview.scenario: 智能影像设备新品上市营销工作流
portfolio_focus: 可复用 Agent / Skill 职责体系

business_problem.summary: Enterprise ecommerce teams need a governed workflow for turning inconsistent product information into traceable creative planning artifacts while preventing unsupported claims, unauthorized assets and unverified business-result promises.
problems: 商品资料格式不统一，缺失字段和风险声明容易被遗漏。
用户洞察、卖点、平台策略、创意结构和视觉规划之间交接成本高。
技术参数、广告表达和视觉素材缺少证据与授权检查。
最终结果难以追踪来源，也难以定位失败发生在哪个节点。
内容效果和 Agent 执行质量缺少统一评估口径。

executed_v1_workflow.scope: Historical Steps 1-11 MVP content asset workflow summarized by Creative Package Reporter.
executed_v1_workflow.boundary: V1 produced structured planning and reporting artifacts only; it did not generate final public-facing creative assets.

designed_v2_workflow.scope: Governed target workflow adding Planner orchestration, Human Approval, Growth Evaluation and Final Report Generator.
sequence: Audience Insight / Selling Point Analyst / Platform Strategy
key_rules: Brief Parser must run before downstream analysis.
Audience Insight, Selling Point Analyst and Platform Strategy can run in parallel after standardized Brief.
Creative Agent waits for the three analysis outputs.
Brand Compliance must run before Human Approval.
Image Prompt Skill remains a single node and should be after Human Approval in V2.
Growth Evaluation reads compliance status and human approval results before evaluation.
Final Report Generator summarizes Planner, approval, evaluation and artifact index.

workflow_difference_note.v1: V1 is the already executed Steps 1-11 historical chain. It produced structured creative planning artifacts and the historical final creative package report.
workflow_difference_note.v2: V2 is the target governance and evaluation workflow. It does not replace or overwrite the V1 report; it summarizes Planner orchestration, Human Approval, Growth Evaluation and the V1 artifact index.
workflow_difference_note.important_distinction: V2 can evaluate and report the workflow, but it does not authorize final marketing copy, final image prompts, image generation or public release.

v1_artifacts.role: Standardizes the product brief and identifies risk fields for downstream agents.
Converts the brief into audience segments, needs, pains, purchase triggers and validation assumptions.
Maps product features to benefits, selling point priority, proof requirements and claim risks.
Defines channel roles, funnel mapping, content formats, cadence, metrics and review gates.
Defines governed copy module structures without writing final public-facing copy.
Defines visual asset structures and multimodal governance without generating model-ready image prompts.
Reviews structured copy and visual planning risks and blocks final generation gates.
Defines observable metrics, A/B directions, tracking fields and retrospective schema.
Summarizes the governed V1 workflow without releasing final creative assets.

node_status_summary.note: Historical structured artifacts exist; final generation remained blocked.
V2 route, node execution plan, risk budget and downstream handoff are defined.
Structured planning may enter evaluation; final generation and public release remain blocked.
Workflow evaluation completed with partial data quality and one completed demo case.
Summarizes existing Planner, approval, evaluation and artifact index only.

responsibility_boundary: Convert standardized Brief and upstream artifacts into executable V2 workflow plan.
Define task decomposition, node routing, node input/output contracts, risk routing, human approval fields, evaluation targets and downstream handoff fields.
Preserve compliance gates and blocked final generation states.
planner_summary.parallel_execution: Audience Insight, Selling Point Analyst and Platform Strategy can run in parallel after standardized Brief.
planner_summary.risk_budget_summary: High-risk fields include unsupported image quality claims, waterproof/stabilization/durability claims, AI auto-editing claims, business result promises, brand/logo/likeness authorization and product/App/scene asset authorization.
blocked_items: using technical parameters as product name or default product facts

major_risk_areas: 高清、全景画质等表达缺少证明材料
防水、防抖、耐用性能声明缺少等级、条件和限制说明
AI 自动剪辑不能承诺爆款、专业结果或商业表现
CTR、CVR、GMV、流量和转化不能作为结果承诺
品牌 Logo、名人肖像、商品图、App 截图和场景样片需要授权
夸张失真的极限户外画面不得进入后续 Prompt 或图片生成

human_approval_summary.important_note: This is a portfolio Demo approval record, not a real enterprise employee signature or authorization proof.

evaluation_scope: Agent workflow completion and artifact structure
Planner routing and downstream handoff quality
Brand Compliance risk detection and blocked gate propagation
Human Approval inheritance and release gate correctness
Metric data availability and source classification
Failure taxonomy, issue attribution and iteration recommendations
growth_evaluation_summary.non_business_result_rule: CTR, CVR, GMV, traffic and conversion are only observation, experiment, dashboard or retrospective fields, not achieved or guaranteed outcomes.

metric_summary.source_type_note: mock, estimated and not_available values are not real business results.

metrics.name: 任务完成率
metrics.summary: Original MVP core nodes were reported as 11/11 for the single 运动相机 demo; V2 governance coverage is counted separately.
metrics.limitation: Cannot infer cross-category stability from one demo.

metrics.name: 平均耗时
metrics.summary: 90-150 minutes Agent workflow estimate vs 360-600 minutes manual baseline estimate.
metrics.limitation: No real timestamped per-node execution logs; not a real efficiency improvement claim.

metrics.name: 幻觉率
metrics.limitation: No reliable numerator or denominator yet.

metrics.name: 合规阻断率 / 审批闸口正确率 / 风险传递完整率
metrics.summary: Current artifacts show blocked gates were preserved and inherited.
metrics.limitation: Needs more benchmark cases and production-grade audit data.

strengths: Planner 路由正确性 is pass_with_caution.
合规风险识别与传递 is pass_with_caution.
Human Approval 闸口正确性 is pass_with_caution.
blocked 内容是否被正确阻止 is pass_with_caution.
needs_review_dimensions: 上下游字段交接完整性

lowest_observed_dimension.reason: Only one completed case is available and some audit data is mock.

issues.summary: Only one completed benchmark case exists; cross-category stability cannot be claimed.
Final generation and public release remain blocked because proof and asset authorization are missing.
Human edit rate and hallucination rate cannot be calculated without manual field annotations.
Traceability exists at artifact level but no automated field-level trace matrix exists yet.
Average time is estimated because real per-node timestamps are unavailable.

release_gates.reason: Evidence, usage conditions, asset authorization and real human approval are incomplete. Evaluation permission does not equal final generation permission.

limitations: Only one complete Demo exists: 运动相机.
便携投影仪 and 美妆精华 benchmark cases are pending and must not be treated as results.
Some metrics are mock or estimated; they are not production evidence.
Human edit rate and hallucination rate are not_available because no field-level annotations exist.
No real campaign CTR, CVR, GMV, traffic, conversion or revenue data exists.
No real reviewer name, signature, timestamp or asset authorization proof exists.
Field-level claim trace matrix is not yet automated.
Final creative generation and public release are still blocked.

iteration_backlog.description: Prepare and execute 便携投影仪 and 美妆精华 through the same workflow before claiming cross-category stability.
Collect product proof, usage-condition boundaries, asset licenses and real approval records before final generation.
Add per-node start/end timestamps and human review annotations to calculate average time, human edit rate and hallucination rate.
Require every claim, risk and recommendation to include source artifact and source field.

iteration_backlog.item: Keep Growth Evaluation distinct from Growth Metrics
iteration_backlog.description: Maintain the difference between Step 10 metrics planning and Step 14 workflow evaluation.

final_conclusion.summary: V2 Final Report Generator completed a governed summary of Planner orchestration, Human Approval, Growth Evaluation and the V1 artifact index. The project demonstrates a ToB multi-agent workflow with compliance and evaluation gates, but it is not ready for final creative generation or public release.
what_is_ready: Structured planning artifacts for portfolio review
V2 route design and risk budget
Human Approval gate record for Demo evaluation
Growth Evaluation findings for one completed 运动相机 case
final_conclusion.reason_for_needs_review: Only one full Demo exists, several metrics are mock/estimated/not_available, proof and asset authorization are missing, and real human approval has not been completed.
